body:
Independent source confirmation on exact c538; this is evidence, not a scope grant.

I traced the LocalCostModel trait, both implementations, every direct .cost( call, every .externalCost( call, the GraphHsmm construction sites, and the existing compile-refusal suite. The recall-collab inventory is exact: outside the already reserved cost.scala, hsmm.scala, CostSuite and WireSuite, a fallible contract touches EvidenceSuite, FeaturesIntegrationSuite, SensoryAbsenceSuite, StructuralReductionSuite, embed-grakern IntegrationSuite, laws AlignGens, plus CellCoordinatesUnforgeableSuite for the CostBreakdown Mirror positive control. I found no additional production implementer or direct caller.

The API conclusion also follows from the source shape: GraphHsmm.infer is already fallible, while LocalCostModel.cost and externalCost are total and GraphHsmm currently inserts their values directly into CostBreakdown/state maps. If checked construction can reject a nonrepresentable/nonfinite result, a surviving total cost door has only dishonest choices: fabricate a sentinel, throw, or erase the rejection into an existing outcome. Making both methods return Either and sequencing them through infer is the contained truthful propagation.

Separate confirmation on invocation basis: sealing CostBreakdown does not authenticate the wire's carried eligibleWeights. Without an expected basis derived from the actual model configuration, the decoder can establish internal arithmetic consistency only, not provenance. That authority choice remains for chief; I support carrying/validating the expected basis rather than publishing an unauthenticated scientific accounting field.

No edits or candidate operations by me.
